_comment: Build choices: each is built in the selected cell and paid from matter within reach of it (reachRadius in universe.json); dismantling refunds the cost. revealRequirements make this the tech tree: a recipe stays hidden until they have all been met once, then it is unlocked for good. Useful checks: epoch (reached an epoch in universe.json), stat (lifetime counters: crafted:<recipe>, opened:<item>, gained:<item>, exposed:<radiation>, done:<action>) and unlocked (recipe:<id> / action:<name>). Costs and unlock thresholds are placeholder tuning.

recipes.label: Quantum Cache
recipes.tooltip: Crush primordial gas into a sealed cache. The crush fuses some of it: a cache collapses into hydrogen, helium, carbon and, rarely, iron.

recipes.label: Nebula Irradiator
recipes.tooltip: A chamber as cool as a glowing gas cloud. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.

recipes.label: Corona Irradiator
recipes.tooltip: A chamber as hot as a star's corona. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.

recipes.label: Optical Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Bathes a cache in visible light, which favours carbon: caches yield more carbon.

recipes.label: Infrared Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls.

recipes.label: Microwave Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Ore extraction: caches yield more iron.

recipes.label: X-Ray Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that.

recipes.label: Gamma Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Needs a corona irradiator.
